listing.name: LocoRoco 2 — Purun (TeamGDB)
listing.summary: Firstlevelplays/saves/continues, later levels have not been tested; missing sound effects/crashrisk. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European UCES01059 ISO. The executable is checked against the expected SHA-256.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released native macOS app from its DMG. Players do not need development tools or recompilation. The separate private source build takes approximately 40 minutes and is intended for developers.

warnings: Firstlevelplays/saves/continues, later levels have not been tested; missing sound effects/crashrisk.
